newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS - Philips features on EOE ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - Philips features on EOE ahead of results.

text.p: Philips put options were the main feature on the European Options Exchange (EOE) on Wednesday as investors braced themselves ahead of the company's third quarter results due early on Thursday.

Turnover in the company's options dwarfed all others, taking nearly 30 percent of the volume. Puts outweighed calls by 22,000 to 17,000 as investors took protection against the results being worse-than-thought. Analysts expect a big restructuring charge.
The EOE contract, relegated to second in the volume list, attracted a roughly even number of calls and puts at around 13,000 each. -- Amsterdam newsdesk +31 20 504 5000
